messages.subject: "global" version of get_seized?
parts: I would like to have arrivals make a decision based on whether one or more resources are currently seized. (I don't want them to simply enter a queue for the resources). Originally I tried using get_seized, however it appeared that the value returned was of how many units the particular arrival doing the query has seized. What I need is the total number of units seized of that resource, including other arrivals (also from other trajectories). Am I missing some correct way to do this? My work-around is to use standard R variables which I increment and decrement on seizes and releases, which is very clunky.

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
